metrics.profile_summary: Experienced graphic designer with over 7 years of expertise in branding, digital media, and print design. Specialized in Adobe Illustrator and interactive designs with a track record of mentoring junior designers.

experience.description: Produced modern content and event visuals aligned with brand identity. Led custom gaming and mascot logo design and managed end-to-end design processes using Adobe Illustrator.
Provided creative branding and visual communication solutions to strengthen business brand presence.

strengths: Strong visual branding and design expertise
weaknesses: Lacks required degree in Marketing or Business Administration
No experience with GA4 or ad platform reporting
No experience in budget management, ROI/CAC/LTV tracking, or overall marketing strategy
Professional profile is creative/execution-focused rather than managerial/strategic
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly skilled Graphic Designer but does not possess the strategic marketing management experience, analytical technical skills (GA4), or educational background required for the Marketing Manager role.
